Tarsal bones (7): talus, calcaneus, navicular, medial cuneiform, intermediate cuneiform, lateral cuneiform, cuboid
Metatarsal bones (5): 1st through 5th metatarsals

- Great toe (hallux): 2 phalanges (proximal and distal)
- Other 4 toes: 3 phalanges each (proximal, middle, distal) = 4 × 3 = 12

Total: 7 + 5 + 14 = 26 bones

So the adult human foot has 26 bones.
